criteria.dimension: Check-in message completeness and real usability

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Message omits a return time, a destination or activity cue, or the change-of-plan clause, and reads as too vague to be useful in real life.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Message includes most required pieces but the wording is still generic or copied closely from the pattern without personalizing it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Message includes a return time and a change-of-plan clause, written in wording the learner could realistically send as their own text.

criteria.dimension: Reasoning about when and why to use it

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Names a situation for using the message but does not explain why it matters or what to do if there is no reply.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names two specific real situations for using the message and describes a reasonable next step if no reply comes back in time.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
